## Summary

Describe the user-visible or protocol behavior changed by this pull request.

## Validation

- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .`
- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has automated coverage
- [ ] Relevant documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated
- [ ] Fixtures and logs contain no credentials or private task data

## Compatibility

Explain any CalDAV, iCalendar, Nextcloud, Android, migration, or offline-sync
impact. Write “None” if the change has no compatibility impact.
